_note: Element advantage. strong: the elements this element deals 125% damage to; weak: the elements it deals 75% to; any other pair 100%. Against an enemy with two elements, each element's +25% or -25% is added (50% to 150%). Read 2026-11-25 from BWIKI 元素 (revision 24270) and from the wikiru page 属性相性表; the two agree.
